race.comment: CHAMBER OF SECRETS (3) looks the horse to beat after winning at Muswellbrook two runs back. Had excuses at Scone when she jumped awkwardly and warmed up late from the rear to finish fourth over 1300m. The one-week back-up is the small query, but her recent form and the booking of Aaron Bullock give her the strongest profile. JOHNNY BOZ (4) is the clear danger after running third at Moree and having traffic issues when beaten only two and a half lengths at this track the run prior. Well drawn and will relish the claim. HIDDEN DETAIL (8) brings winning form after beating Akuma in a Maiden at Moree and gets the 3kg claim. Can go on with it here. AGE OF AQUARIUS (7) resumed with a narrow Armidale win and has a sound record around this trip. Ben Looker stays aboard but he doesn't get the same map favours. Slim claims.
